page.layout: One page of text: running head at top centre; a title and emblem heading; below a framed woodcut (emblem border, no text inside); below the frame a verse epigram in italic lines; at the foot a word "Homo" in large type.

main_text.l: Cœu rutilis idem qui dissilit ignibus æther,
Vita fide sic Christus erit tibi vera receptus,
Spretus at hic idem mors tibi Christus erit.

page.notes: The initial C of the verse is a large woodcut letter, joined to the first word as "Cœu". The verse is set in italic; the text is transcribed as printed. The woodcut frame encloses an empty central field and is not text. Heading numeral printed as XXXXI in the scan, reproduced as printed in the heading line "XXXXI." Some letters of the verse lines are uncertain where the scan is faint.
